title.pinyin: Nǐ jiā lí gōngsī yuǎn ma
title.english: Do you live far from your company

instruction.hanzi: 给下面的词语选择对应的图片
instruction.english: Match the pictures with the words/phrases.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 没有,他还在教室学习呢。
dialogue.pinyin: Méiyǒu, tā hái zài jiàoshì xuéxí ne.
dialogue.english: No. He is still studying in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 已经9点多了,他怎么还在学习?
dialogue.pinyin: Yǐjīng jiǔ diǎn duō le, tā zěnme hái zài xuéxí?
dialogue.english: It's after 9 o'clock. Why is he still studying?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 明天有考试,他说今天要好好准备。
dialogue.pinyin: Míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì, tā shuō jīntiān yào hǎohao zhǔnbèi.
dialogue.english: There's a test tomorrow. He says he'll prepare well today.

title.english: On the way to the airport

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 在去机场的路上。你已经到了吗?
dialogue.pinyin: Zài qù jīchǎng de lùshang. Nǐ yǐjīng dào le ma?
dialogue.english: I'm on the way to the airport. Have you arrived?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 我下飞机了。你还有多长时间能到这儿?
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xià fēijī le. Nǐ hái yǒu duō cháng shíjiān néng dào zhèr?
dialogue.english: I've got off the plane. How many more minutes do you need to get here?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ jiā lí gōngsī yuǎn ma?
dialogue.english: Do you live far from your company?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 很远,坐公共汽车要一个多小时呢!
dialogue.pinyin: Hěn yuǎn, zuò gōnggòng qìchē yào yí ge duō xiǎoshí ne!
dialogue.english: Yes, very far. It takes more than an hour by bus.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 坐公共汽车太慢了,你怎么不开车?
dialogue.pinyin: Zuò gōnggòng qìchē tài màn le, nǐ zěnme bù kāi chē?
dialogue.english: Buses are slow. Why don't you drive?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 开车也不快,路上车太多了!
dialogue.pinyin: Kāi chē yě bú kuài, lùshang chē tài duō le!
dialogue.english: It's not fast either. There are too many cars on the road.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 今天晚上我们一起吃饭吧,给你过生日。
dialogue.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshang wǒmen yìqǐ chī fàn ba, gěi nǐ guò shēngrì.
dialogue.english: Let's have dinner together tonight to celebrate your birthday.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 今天?离我的生日还有一个多星期呢!
dialogue.pinyin: Jīntiān? Lí wǒ de shēngrì hái yǒu yí ge duō xīngqī ne!
dialogue.english: Tonight? My birthday is more than a week away!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 下个星期我要去北京,今天过吧。
dialogue.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqī wǒ yào qù Běijīng, jīntiān guò ba.
dialogue.english: Next week I'll be in Beijing. Let's celebrate today.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 好吧,离这儿不远有一个中国饭馆,走几分钟就到了。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo ba, lí zhèr bù yuǎn yǒu yí ge Zhōngguó fànguǎn, zǒu jǐ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
dialogue.english: Fine. There's a Chinese restaurant nearby — only a few minutes' walk away.

explanation.hanzi: 表示动作或状态的延续,否定式用"还没"。
explanation.english: Indicates the continuation of an action or state. The negative form is "还没" ("not yet").

examples.pinyin: Bā diǎn le, tā hái zài shuì jiào.
examples.english: It's 8 o'clock and he's still sleeping.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme hái méi chī fàn?
Tā hái zài jiàoshì xuéxí ne.
examples.english: He's still studying in the classroom.

explanation.hanzi: 强调说话人认为事情发生得早,进行得快、顺利。
explanation.english: Used for emphasis — the speaker thinks something happened early, or went fast and smoothly.

rows: 坐飞机一个半小时就到北京了。

explanation.hanzi: 用来表示处所、时间、目的的距离。
explanation.english: Used to indicate the distance from a place, a moment, or a purpose.

explanation.hanzi: 用于陈述句尾,可用在形容词谓语句和动词谓语句后边,表示确认事实,使对方信服,含有夸张的语气。
explanation.english: Sentence-final "呢" follows an adjectival or verbal predicate to confirm a fact and convince the listener, often with an exaggerated tone.

examples.pinyin: Bā diǎn shàng kè, shíjiān hái zǎo ne.
examples.english: Class starts at eight — there's still plenty of time.

examples.hanzi: 医院离我们这儿还远呢。
examples.pinyin: Yīyuàn lí wǒmen zhèr hái yuǎn ne.
examples.english: The hospital is still far from us.

examples.hanzi: 坐公共汽车要一个多小时呢!
examples.pinyin: Zuò gōnggòng qìchē yào yí ge duō xiǎoshí ne!
examples.english: Taking the bus takes more than an hour!

prompt.hanzi: 根据课文内容回答问题
prompt.english: Answer the questions based on the dialogs.

items.hanzi: 九点多了,大卫为什么还不休息?
items.pinyin: Jiǔ diǎn duō le, Dàwèi wèi shénme hái bù xiūxi?

items.hanzi: 坐公共汽车一个小时能到公司吗?
items.pinyin: Zuò gōnggòng qìchē yí ge xiǎoshí néng dào gōngsī ma?

items.hanzi: 公司离家很远,她为什么不开车?
items.pinyin: Gōngsī lí jiā hěn yuǎn, tā wèi shénme bù kāi chē?

items.hanzi: 今天不是她的生日,为什么她朋友要今天给她过生日?
items.pinyin: Jīntiān bú shì tā de shēngrì, wèi shénme tā péngyou yào jīntiān gěi tā guò shēngrì?

examples: 放 fàng (to let go, to set free)
